title: Superradiant Mpemba Relaxation in a Dicke Ladder
summary: The Mpemba effect occurs when a state initially farther from stationarity overtakes a closer one during relaxation. We show that this anomalous ordering can coexist with superradiant emission in a collectively damped ensemble of two-level systems. In the symmetric Dicke manifold, zero-temperature decay is a population cascade with rates $Γn(N-n+1)$. We construct the sparse family $ρ_A=|\lceil2N/3\rceil\rangle\langle\lceil2N/3\rceil|$ and $ρ_B=(|0\rangle\langle0|+|N\rangle\langle N|)/2$.
